fullDesc: FromSoftware released Elden Ring on February 25, 2022. The open-world game, with world-building by author George R. R. Martin, sold millions within weeks and won Game of the Year at The Game Awards.
realFacts: It sold 12 million copies in its first month
A major expansion, Shadow of the Erdtree, released in 2024
Its difficulty sparked wide debate about game design
